address.label: Shezan Cakes and Snacks, Mallepally
address.formal_address: 11, 3-913/1, Jamia Masjid Rd, Mozampura, Mallepally, New Mallepally, Hyderabad, Telangana 500001

distinguishing_features: Commercial bakery storefront on the main road
Clear 'Shezan Cakes And Snack' branding and display counters visible from the street

approach_from.direction_label: Coming via Vijayanagar Colony / Mallepally X Roads
approach_from.instructions: Head towards Jamia Masjid Road from Mallepally X Roads. The shop is on the main road, near the mosque.

approach_from.direction_label: Coming via Asif Nagar Main Road
approach_from.instructions: Turn onto Jamia Masjid Road leading into Mallepally, proceed straight toward the Jamia Masjid landmark, and look for the storefront.

entrance_details.identifying_marks: Large 'Shezan Cakes And Snack' signage above the entrance
entrance_details.access_notes: Ground-floor commercial street access, direct walk-in during business hours — no gate, no security, no floor/unit navigation needed
